Initial release of mcp-control, enabling browser and Windows automation for Mavis.

- Provides unified control over Edge browser (via official playwright-cli) and Windows desktop (via PowerShell + .NET helper).
- All browser actions are text-based and accessibility tree-driven; no screenshot flash or vision models required.
- Includes common operations: tab management, a11y snapshots, search, click/fill/type, navigation, scripting, and screenshots (browser & desktop).
- Offers robust Windows desktop automation: window management, input control (mouse/keyboard), clipboard, shell/PowerShell commands, and screenshots.
- Includes quick start instructions and built-in config for integration with Mavis and Claude Desktop.
- Safety notes included to highlight powerful capabilities and user impact.
